findings.failure_scenario: Adding invariant_producers {schemaVersion:'1.0.0',bindings:[]} as step 2 says makes `node --test tools/devai/tests/ci-isolation.test.mjs` fail at assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(policy,'invariant_producers'), false). The packet makes this test a mandatory acceptance gate and forbids weakening assertions, so acceptance cannot pass. Fixing it means changing the test, which is outside the single-file write set. The packet needs to add that test file to the authorized delta, for example by asserting the declared key is exactly the closed empty form with bindings length 0 and still asserting no measurable_via. As written it cannot be executed.
